title: Song select
description: ledger: the session stats in song select's free centre column (between the local leaderboard and the beatmap carousel, above the bottom bar). osu! shows no session information anywhere.

title: Gameplay
description: minimal: attempt number, session length, a short attempt strip and pass / fail / retry counts beside the playfield.

title: Results
description: line: one line in the free right part of the results header with session plays, passes, best pp (NEW when this pass beat it) and profile pp change since the session started.

title: Gameplay side
description: Side of the playfield / mania stage for the gameplay counter (taiko: below the lane). Falls back to the other side when the stage leaves too little room.

title: Scale
description: Size of everything, 0.6–1.6.

title: Gameplay nudge X / px
description: Moves the gameplay counter inward (positive) from the screen edge.

title: Gameplay nudge Y / px
description: Moves the gameplay counter down (positive) or up (negative).

title: Song select nudge X / px
description: Moves the song select ledger right (positive) or left (negative) from the centre column.

title: Song select nudge Y / px
description: Moves the song select ledger down (positive) or up (negative).

title: Results nudge X / px
description: Moves the results line right (positive) or left (negative).

title: Results nudge Y / px
description: Moves the results line down (positive) or up (negative).

title: Backing
description: none: type floats on the game with a contrast shadow. scrim: a soft dark fade behind each cluster for bright backgrounds. panel: a graphite 18-LAB panel.

title: Accent
description: map: highlights (live attempt bar, NEW, session label) take the beatmap's tonal-spot colour. 18-lab: always amber.

title: Ledger: plays
description: Attempts, time spent in gameplay and the share of attempts that reached results.

title: Ledger: attempt strip
description: One bar per attempt, newest on the right: tall bars are passes in their grade colour, red outlines are fails, short grey bars are retries (restarts and quits before the end).

title: Ledger: best pp
description: Highest-pp pass this session with grade, accuracy and map.

title: Ledger: average accuracy
description: Mean accuracy of this session's passes.

title: Ledger: grade tally
description: Passes per grade; silver SS/S count with SS/S.

title: Ledger: profile change
description: Profile pp and global rank change since the session started (osu! shows the current values, not the change), tracked per account and ruleset.

title: Keep session
description: off: every page load starts a new session. reload: survives refreshing the browser source (session storage, lost when OBS closes it). day: kept until the daily reset hour, even across OBS restarts (local storage).

title: Daily reset hour
description: Local hour (0–23) when a new session day begins; a running session restarts then and stored sessions from an earlier day are discarded. -1 never resets automatically.

title: Reset now
description: Change this number to any other value to start a fresh session immediately.
